justifications.durability: the transform is pinned by a repo-resident synthetic test (test_writer_reads_back_at_dd_4_1_1 asserts 89.72 deg from an in-repo deck), so a revert is caught without external data. The stronger phase-vs-skin cross-check is guarded by REAL_GEO/REAL_COIL_VV paths under ~/.config/reckon/crew/reports (outside the repository) and skips with pytest.skip when absent, so in a clean checkout it silently skips. The regenerated stores and figures live under /work and are not reproducible from the repository alone.
justifications.evidence: the both-phase test is an independent cross-check: the stored axis derives from geo.in omega, the reference tangent from the coil_vv vessel inner skin, and both phase skins are correctly taken from their own deck (coil_vv_OP1 for OP1). The declared mutation (restoring deg2rad(omega)) turns the skin-tangent test and the synthetic read-back red (negative_control_probe_axis.log: 2 failed, EXIT=1), so the guard fires. Re-measured independently at head: max departure 3.33 deg (OP1 and OP2), MP1 89.72 deg, every probe's nearest skin chord within 0.018 m (<= the fragment's 0.021 m bound).
justifications.fit: the fragment's element ids are all prefixed jtmm-probe-axis-store- and it follows the sibling evidence-fragment idiom; the four commits carry conventional subjects with bodies and no attribution; the converter comment states the mechanism and its declared convention, with no plan or ticket identifier in source or tests.
justifications.goal_fidelity: imas_ambix/data/selene_deck.py now writes float(np.deg2rad((90.0 - probe.angle) % 360.0)) with the convention stated in the comment; tests/data/test_selene_deck.py adds test_stored_probe_axes_lie_along_the_vessel_inner_skin (both phases within 5 deg mod 180 of the nearest skin tangent, MP1 within 1 deg of 90) and updates test_writer_reads_back_at_dd_4_1_1 to 89.72 deg; the OP1/OP2 receipts under /work record converter commit 4ad783e6, 17 probes and MP1 89.72 deg; superseded/OP1 and superseded/OP2 exist; both SVGs are re-rendered with the unchanged scripts/figures_jt60sa_geometry.py; ruff check on the changed paths exits 0.
justifications.reuse: build_magnetics is changed in place, no public definition is added or retired, and the re-render reuses the existing geometry script; the diff forks no capability the repository owns.
justifications.scope_discipline: the five changed paths across the run's four commits are exactly declared; nothing outside the grants was written, and the unused figure grant was not populated.
